title: RDS Data API coverage
intro: The five RDS Data API operations the emulator advertises. The service is REST-JSON
`ExecuteStatement` runs against the emulator's in-memory SQL stub when the target has
no container-backed endpoint, which is how a serverless cluster answers. Batch and the
three transaction operations bind a real database connection, so their tests create a
PostgreSQL instance on a lab whose emulator can start containers and prove each effect
by reading it back; without that socket they skip and name the dependant.
